# Slate inventory + bonus overview

- **Status:** ⚠️ Unverified
- **Mechanic tags:** build-system, slates

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Shipped in the engine; not yet verified in-game. Saved-slates inventory + summed-bonuses overview (SlateOverview); Max-Divinity dedup hardened.

## Implementation (engine model)

Renderer-only display summary (the DPS engine does its own separate pooling). `utils/slateBonusSummary.ts::summarizeSlateBonuses` takes the raw effect lines printed on placed slates and consolidates them: `splitMultiStat` splits attribute-only `+N A and B` lines (Strength/Dexterity/Intelligence) into per-stat lines (broad `A and B` splitting is deliberately avoided); lines are grouped by `affixIdentity(line)` preserving first-seen order; identical numeric lines are summed arithmetically (`8% ×3 → 24%`); `Max Divinity Effect: 1` lines (matched by `MAX_DIV_RE`) are counted exactly once via a `seenMaxDiv` set (value-insensitive, mirroring the engine) and never summed. Each output `SlateBonusLine` re-formats the summed leading number (`fmt`, up-to-2-decimals trimmed) and carries `badgeText` (Max-Divinity tag stripped) for the modifier-status resolver. `SlateScreen.tsx` renders the saved-slate inventory (unlimited; keyed by stable `templateId`), on-board copy mechanics (Moth/Prairie/Space Rift/Residence), and feeds placed slates' lines to `summarizeSlateBonuses` for the overview; per-slate removal DPS delta is computed for placed tiles only.
